events.title: Game Update 0.0.20 - Taxes, Shops & Books
events.summary: Now live, books, shops and yes...TAXES! I'll start with the good news. You can now create and write/read/copy books and your journal. This makes your writing and drawings world items! You can also make shops in town to sell, buy and auction. The number of slots available to you depends on your Merchant skill. And the not so popular news. Taxes have been added to the game. events.title: Death & Taxes Demo Update 0.0.061
events.summary: Of course, as things go, there were some bugs in that first build of the demo that just could not wait to be addressed. If you started the game tutorial and you were falling off the ship, we've fixed that. You may need to delete your save file to start over. You can find it here: C:\\Users\\YOURUSERNAME\\AppData\\LocalLow\\RedTigerPro\\Project Spellweaver 2 Please join us on Discord for news and announcements.Patch Notes 0.0.061 - Oct. 8, 2025Updates:Added 2 boards to beachMade boards 25% Larger

events.title: Death & Taxes Demo Update 0.0.06
events.summary: That's right, we've got our first demo update live and we've added some great stuff already. First is the brand new UI. Professionally designed menus, buttons and icons are looking pretty good. Next, we've started working on our AI NPC. As of right now he just talks to the player...and he really wants to trade with you. We have plans for an entire NPC faction so keep an eye on this space! Please join us on Discord for news and announcements. Patch Notes 0.0.06 - Oct. 5, 2025Updates:Ongoing work
